findings.current: “Send me to the place The Prophet—no, the Doppelganger—first told us about.”
findings.defect: “Us” specifies who was told about the place, though the Korean leaves the recipient unstated.
findings.rationale: The source identifies the place and who revealed it, but not the recipient of that information.
findings.replacement: “Send me to the place the Prophet—no, the Doppelganger—first revealed.”
findings.source: “절 보내 줘요. 처음 선지자가, 아니 도플갱어가 알려 줬던 그 장소로.”

findings.current: He was ashamed of himself for making this choice.
findings.defect: The draft loses Johnson’s sense that he has no choice.
findings.rationale: 할 수 밖에 없는 explicitly frames the decision as unavoidable.
findings.replacement: He was ashamed of himself for having no choice but to make it.
findings.source: 이런 선택을 할 수 밖에 없는 스스로가 부끄러웠다.

findings.current: Magic Johnson muttered a curse, his strength failing him.
findings.defect: The draft turns a weakly spoken curse into an assertion that Johnson’s physical strength is failing.
findings.rationale: 힘없이 describes how he mutters; it does not establish a new physical decline.
findings.replacement: Magic Johnson muttered a curse weakly.
